ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image, from left to right, there is a small aquatic organism, several fish, and a bird standing on the far right. Arrows connect these organisms in sequence, and the clearly visible arrow on the far right points from the fish on the right to the bird on the far right. Reasoning: The question asks from which organism to which organism energy flows. According to the direction of the arrows in the image, the last energy-flow relationship is from fish to bird, so energy flows from fish to bird.
